Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: UpscaleBuddy
Description:
Runs temporal upscaling and anti-aliasing through the game's own DLSS path.
Built-in FSR 3.1 works on any GPU; AMD's FSR DLL over D3D12 adds FSR 4 where the GPU and driver support it, and Intel's XeSS runs over D3D12 too.
Supports the quality presets and Native AA.
Open the settings with /upscalebuddy
Punchline: FSR 3.1, FSR 4 and XeSS upscaling and anti-aliasing.
